summary.text: Phil Isley is an Undeclared candidate for Alaska House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside incumbent Carolyn Hall (D) and Liz Vazquez (R).
According to Ballotpedia, Isley is an aircraft mechanic who served in the Alaska Army National Guard from 1972 to 1994.
